title: PCR Protocol for MgSTS Marker Genotyping
author: Matthew Farnitano
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.baf3ibqn
materials: Determine the amount of reagents needed. The following amounts are sufficient for a single reaction: 2.95 µL, Molecular Biology Grade Water 2 µL, 5X GoTaq Flexi Buffer, colorless 0.8 µL, MgCl2, 25mM stock 0.8 µL, dNTPs, 2.5mM stock 0.5 µL, BSA, 10 mg/mL stock .2 µL, Premixed F+R Primers, 5uM stock 0.15 µL, GoTaq G2 polymerase, 5 units/uL stock 2 µL, DNA sample Note: Markers that are known to amplify in different, non-overlapping length ranges can be combined into a single PCR reaction. Add 0.2 µL of EACH premixed primer pair, and reduce your water volume accordingly so that the final reaction volume is 10 µL .

steps.title: Prepare Reagents
steps.instruction: Thaw all mix components except for GoTaq polymerase, which must remain in the freezer until needed.

steps.title: Create PCR Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a master mix containing all ingredients except DNA, adding the polymerase last.

steps.title: Prepare PCR Plate
steps.instruction: Distribute the master mix and DNA samples into a PCR plate.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 8 µL of master mix to each well
Add 2 µL sample DNA to each well
Apply a plastic seal and press all edges to ensure it is tight
Spin the plate to collect droplets

steps.title: Run PCR Cycler Program
steps.instruction: Place the plate in the PCR machine and run the following program:

substeps.instruction: 10 cycles of stepping down annealing temp: 94 °C (0 mins 30 sec), 62 °C reducing by 1 °C every cycle to 53 °C (0 mins 45 sec), 72 °C (1 min 00 sec)
35 cycles of constant annealing temp: 94 °C (0 mins 30 sec), 52 °C (0 mins 45 sec), 72 °C (1 min 00 sec)

steps.title: Prepare Samples for Sequencing
steps.instruction: Prepare a new plate with the following reaction components (HiDi and ROX size standard can be premixed and aliquoted beforehand):

substeps.instruction: Add 0.25 µL ROX size standard (use ROX1000 for marker lengths > 500; use ROX500 for smaller lengths)

steps.title: Finalize and Submit Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare the plate for transport to the sequencing provider.

substeps.instruction: Briefly spin down the plate to remove air bubbles and sample stuck to the sides
